title: Treasure chest
instruction: You find a treasure chest. If you have the key, you're asked for the secret code (742). The right code opens the chest; a wrong one keeps it shut. With no key, you can't even try!
hint: An if can live inside another if: indent it one more step.

blocks.code: answer = input("Do you have the key? (yes/no) ")
print("Click! The chest opens. 100 gold coins!")
print("Wrong code! The chest stays shut.")
print("The chest is locked. Go and find the key!")

expectedOutput: Do you have the key? (yes/no) yes
Click! The chest opens. 100 gold coins!
